tagline: 奥林巴斯胶片相机，1986 年发布
description: 奥林巴斯于1986年推出的胶片相机。快门速度1/30–1/500 s. Electronic self-timer.。使用Auto-loading, auto-winding, auto-rewind.。感光度DX coded films ISO 50–3200.。Active infrared autofocus with focus lock, 0.75 m to infinity.。

specs.对焦: Active infrared autofocus with focus lock, 0.75 m to infinity.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in, GN 12, quickly recharging, automatically activated.
specs.英文简介: AFL-T or Quick Shooter Tele, released in 1986, was Olympus's first camera with twin focal lengths, following in the steps of the Fuji TW-300 and Konica MR.70.
